h5_paths.mnps_3d: Canonical 3D MNPS trajectory [T,3] in axis order [m,d,e].
h5_paths.window_start: Per-epoch window start times [T] in seconds.
h5_paths.window_end: Per-epoch window end times [T] in seconds.
h5_paths.nn/indices: k-nearest-neighbor indices used for local Jacobian estimation.
h5_paths.jacobian/J_hat: Windowed Jacobian tensor [W,3,3] on primary MNPS.
h5_paths.jacobian_9D/J_hat: Windowed Jacobian on stratified coordinates (dimension depends on config).
h5_paths.jacobian_9D/cross_partials/*: Named cross-partial timeseries extracted from jacobian_9D.
h5_paths.feature_anchors/spec attrs: MNDM 2.1 feature-anchor identity, source policy, and hash.
h5_paths.feature_anchors/per_feature/*: Per-feature anchor center/scale statistics aligned by feature_name.
h5_paths.anchor_state/values: Noetic Anchoring Dynamics aligned anchor-state matrix [T,Q]. Separate from cohort feature_anchors.
h5_paths.anchor_coupling/*: Optional additive body-brain coupling diagnostics (for example J_xa/J_ax blocks and metrics).
h5_paths.features_raw/values: Per-epoch raw feature matrix [T,K] in original scale.
h5_paths.features_raw/metadata/*: Machine-readable per-feature metadata aligned to features_raw/names.
h5_paths.features_robust_z/values: Per-epoch strict robust-z feature matrix [T,K] (no log10/clip baked in).
h5_paths.features_robust_z/metadata/*: Machine-readable per-feature metadata aligned to features_robust_z/names.
h5_paths.participant/row_json: Serialized participant-table row for this subject, copied from the resolved participants file.
h5_paths.participant/mapped_json: Canonical mapped metadata derived from participant fields and YAML rules (e.g. group, condition, task).
h5_paths.participant/source_json: Provenance for the participant-table lookup, including source path/format and subject-id column used.
h5_paths.participant attrs field_*: Scalar participant fields mirrored as H5 attrs for fast access without parsing JSON.
h5_paths.participant attrs mapped_*: Scalar mapped metadata mirrored as H5 attrs, e.g. mapped_group, mapped_condition, mapped_task.
h5_paths.participant attrs source_*: Scalar provenance attrs for the participant table source.
h5_paths.extensions/time_reference/run/*: Run-level clock provenance and anchor-relative offsets (schema_version, status, parser, run start/end).
h5_paths.extensions/time_reference/windows/*: Window-level aligned timelines relative to run and anchor (start/end arrays, bin id/labels).
h5_paths.extensions/tabular_exports/*: Columnar exports of CSV-style summary tables embedded into H5.
h5_paths.labels/stage: Optional stage labels aligned to time.
h5_paths.event_windows/*: Additive row-per-pair event-to-window alignment table for exact event-locked joins.
h5_paths.codebooks/stage/*: Explicit stage codebook arrays (codes, labels, label_keys).
h5_paths.participant/clinical_json: Additive richer participant/session metadata embedded as JSON.
h5_paths.coverage/*: Explicit coverage contract for axes, coordinate layers, and Jacobian center mappings.
h5_paths.provenance/*: Structured export-contract, anchoring, normalization, and event/stage provenance.
h5_paths.provenance/geometry_contract/*: Always-on mathematical invalidity contract for canonical MNPS/coords_9d/Jacobian export.
h5_paths.qc/windows/*: Light-weight per-window QC contract aligned to /time.
h5_paths.regions/bold: Optional regional signals (e.g., fMRI ROI x time).
h5_paths.regions/names: Names corresponding to rows in regions/bold.
h5_paths.blocks/stage_code: Block-native: stage/condition code for each block [B].
h5_paths.blocks/start_sec: Block-native: block start times in seconds [B].
h5_paths.blocks/end_sec: Block-native: block end times in seconds [B].
h5_paths.blocks/frequency_hz: Block-native: inferred block parameter/frequency when available [B].
h5_paths.blocks/source_event_idx: Block-native: source event row index used to seed each block [B].
h5_paths.blocks/support_event_count: Block-native: number of supporting in-block events [B].
h5_paths.blocks/derived_from: Block-native: block source kind (stage_blocking, duration_events, task_phase).
h5_paths.blocks/end_reason: Block-native: reason used to terminate each inferred block [B].
h5_paths.blocks/membership_mode: Block-native: membership mode policy used by stage_blocking when available.
h5_paths.blocks/is_inferred: Block-native: 1 when block boundaries are inferred (0 for explicit-duration events).
h5_paths.block_windows/block_id: Block-native: block identifier for each window [N].
h5_paths.block_windows/stage_code: Block-native: stage code inherited from parent block [N].
h5_paths.block_windows/relative_time_in_block_sec: Block-native: window center minus block start [N].
h5_paths.block_windows/distance_to_block_end_sec: Block-native: block end minus window center [N].
h5_paths.block_windows/source_window_index: Block-native: nearest source MNPS window index for exact joins [N].
h5_paths.block_windows/partition_label: Block-native: partition/bin label string per window [N].
h5_paths.block_windows/is_post_offset: Block-native: 1 if window falls after block_end [N].

naming_notes.coordinate_layers: MNDM 2.1 explicit coordinate contracts; subject-anchored is for within-subject dynamics, cohort-anchored is for clinical group contrasts.
naming_notes.feature_anchors: Frozen feature-scaling reference used to construct cohort/external-anchored coordinate layers.
naming_notes.anchor_state: Embodied/interoceptive state export aligned to the canonical MNPS time grid; not the same concept as feature_anchors.
naming_notes.mnps_9d: Configuration/runtime term for stratified MNPS coordinate system.
naming_notes.capabilities.regional_outputs: True when H5 files embed derived `/regional_mnps/*` network-level outputs.
naming_notes.capabilities.raw_region_signals: True when H5 files embed raw `/regions/*` signals (typically fMRI ROI x time).
naming_notes.capabilities.regional_outputs_path: Canonical regional output path for all modalities.
naming_notes.capabilities.raw_features: True when H5 files embed `/features_raw/*` feature exports.
naming_notes.capabilities.robust_z_features: True when H5 files embed `/features_robust_z/*` feature exports.
naming_notes.capabilities.anchor_state: True when H5 files embed `/anchor_state/*` aligned anchor-state exports.
naming_notes.capabilities.anchor_quality: True when H5 files embed `/anchor_quality/*` aligned anchor signal-quality exports.
naming_notes.capabilities.anchor_coupling: True when H5 files embed `/anchor_coupling/*` additive coupling diagnostics.
naming_notes.capabilities.time_reference: True when H5 files embed `/extensions/time_reference/*` timeline provenance.
naming_notes.capabilities.has_block_native_windows: True when H5 files embed `/block_windows/*` block-native window tables.
naming_notes.capabilities.coordinate_contracts: Requested vs realized coordinate contracts inferred from config and emitted H5 layers.
naming_notes.participant: Subject-level participant metadata export group embedded into each H5.
naming_notes.participant_mapped_meta: Canonical metadata derived from participant rows plus YAML extraction rules.
naming_notes.geometry_contract: Always-on canonical validity contract. Use this, not review_qc, to decide whether exported geometry is mathematically usable downstream.

source.source: Dataset provenance metadata declared in the active YAML config.
source.doi: Dataset DOI copied from config when available for acknowledgements and traceability.

mnps_v3_4_external_anchor.transfer_reason: Predeclared descriptive session-repeatability application of one frozen ds005385 EyesClosed scalp-EEG anchor to ds004148 sessions 2 and 3. No target-session refit; acquisition and time-separated-session comparability remain exploratory.
